label: Polycrystalline Al2O3:Nd3+ spiral waveguide amplifier, 5.5 cm, bidirectional 805 nm pump, 1064 nm signal
core_material: polycrystalline Al2O3:Nd3+ (Nd about 2.2e20 ions/cm3, estimated from the 521 nm absorption against RBS-calibrated samples), reactive RF co-sputtered (AJA ATC 1500; Al and Nd targets), film 671.79 nm at wafer centre (VASE); channel 1.04 um x 650 nm (STEM), EBL (AR-N 7520.18 negative resist) + ICP-RIE, on 8 um thermal SiO2 / Si (4-inch)
cladding: SiO2: about 1 um LPCVD TEOS, anneal 800 C in N2, then 6 um PECVD
notes: Fab: no fabrication statement naming a fabricator (passive verbs throughout Sec. 3, p.4-5; authors at University of Twente MESA+ and ALUVIA Photonics): fab empty (D80b). No shared facility named. Acknowledged CMAM (Universidad Autonoma de Madrid) beam time was for RBS of calibration samples, not fabrication: not a facility (garciablanco2025 / bonneville2024 precedent); FIB milling thanks to a named person (staff thanks, D84b). Headline device: fiber-to-fiber (external) net gain with PM780-XP butt-coupled fibers and index-matching gel; Ti:sapphire pump split 50:50 for bidirectional pumping; system losses (13.4 dB) and OSA losses calibrated out (Eq. (2), p.7). Spiral minimum bend radius 300 um (design, chosen from the Fig. 1(d) simulation, p.3) has no amplifier parameter: not entered. Nd3+ concentration about 2.2e20 ions/cm3 (p.4), PL spectrum and excited-state lifetime 184 us (Fig. 3, p.5), refractive index 1.733 +/- 0.003 at 1064 nm (VASE, p.4) have no registry parameter: not entered. Design sidewall angle 83 deg (Fig. 1(a) simulation label) noted only. Single-mode TE design (p.2); measurement polarization not stated (PM fibers). Internal net gain at the 14.5 dB external point (14.5 + 2 x 4.0 = 22.5 dB) is not printed; the paper prints its per-length form 4.1 dB/cm; entered as derived (m20, D166). Fig. 6(a): the y tick marks are evenly spaced and labelled 13, 9, 6, 3, 0, -3, -6, -9, -13; the labels are integer-truncated values of a linear -13 to 13 dB axis (ticks at +/-9.75, +/-6.5, +/-3.25), on which the printed 11.9 / 5.6 / 3.3 dB reproduce at the trace ends (vector read 11.86 / 5.64 / 3.28 dB); Fig. 9(a) x labels truncate 1.5 dBm steps the same way. Gain values from the text. Cited Er:Al2O3 / Nd:Al2O3 values of other works not entered.
